verified_facts.text: The resort is set on Isola delle Rose, a private island in Venice.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled on Isola delle Rose, a private island, our Venice resort offers a tranquil retreat from the city's excitement.

verified_facts.text: The resort grounds cover 40 acres of gardens and olive groves.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 40-acre paradise of gardens, olive groves, and world-class amenities

verified_facts.text: Isola delle Rose has a refreshing microclimate where the lagoon meets the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Isola delle Rose is a natural retreat, boasting a uniquely refreshing microclimate where the lagoon meets the sea.

verified_facts.text: Guests arrive at the resort by boat.
verified_facts.excerpt: with arrival by boat as a distinctly glamorous start

verified_facts.text: Isola delle Rose was created in 1870 and is the youngest island in the Venetian lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Isola delle Rose is the youngest island in the Venetian lagoon, ‘created’ in 1870

verified_facts.text: For a hundred years, the island was home to a clinic.
verified_facts.excerpt: For a hundred years, the island was home to a clinic.

verified_facts.text: Matteo Thun worked with the island's existing buildings, protecting their 1920s character.
verified_facts.excerpt: He worked with the existing 19 buildings, protecting the 1920s character, with his ‘box in a box’ concept.

verified_facts.text: The JW rooms and suites are in the main building, while the JW Retreats are set in private gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: The JW rooms and suites are situated in the main building of our resort, while the JW Retreats are set in private gardens offering quiet seclusion.

verified_facts.text: Accommodation includes La Residenza with private pools, La Maisonette Suites with a plunge pool or garden, and the self-contained Villa Rose.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Residenza with private pools, La Maisonette Suites, with plunge pool or garden, and the entirely self-contained Villa Rose.

verified_facts.text: Villa Rose sleeps up to seven guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The largest occupancy room at JW Marriott Venice Resort & Spa is the Villa Rose with a maximum occupancy of 7.

verified_facts.text: Residences with private gardens have dedicated check-in at the JW Retreats.
verified_facts.excerpt: For extra privacy, residences with private gardens offer an exclusive level of service, with dedicated check-in at the JW Retreats.

verified_facts.text: The JW Venice Spa offers massage and beauty treatments, including a hair spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: The JW Venice Spa, Venice's most comprehensive spa, offers a range of massage and beauty treatments in a blissfully secluded setting, including a hair spa.

verified_facts.text: The resort has an indoor-outdoor heated Vitality Pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: unwind at the JW Venice Spa and our indoor-outdoor heated Vitality Pool

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool has 360-degree views, and the family pool is surrounded by a century-old park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dramatic 360-degrees view rooftop pool and family pool surrounded by the century old park.

verified_facts.text: Guests can rent a private cabana at the Rooftop Pool or the Family Pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy your pool day at the Rooftop Pool or at the Family Pool in total relax and privacy renting a private cabana.

verified_facts.text: Sagra, the restaurant on the hotel's fourth floor, looks over the park and the Venetian lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Sagra restaurant on the 4th floor of the Hotel, offers the most spectacular view of the park and the lagoon of Venice.

verified_facts.text: The resort handpicks, cold-presses and ages its own Isola delle Rose extra virgin olive oil from its olive grove.
verified_facts.excerpt: From our olive grove of a hundred trees, we handpick, cold-press, and age our own Isola delle Rose extra virgin olive oil

verified_facts.text: At the Sapori Cooking Academy, guests learn to create a whole menu in the Venetian culinary tradition.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn how to create a whole menu in the Venetian culinary tradition.

verified_facts.text: Many of the vegetables and fruits on the menu are grown in the JW Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many of the vegetables & fruits on the menu are grown in our JW Garden.

verified_facts.text: The Recreation Team arranges activities from volleyball to Venetian mask making.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Kid's Club is available upon request and our Recreation Team arrange play and pleasure from volleyball to Venetian mask making.

verified_facts.text: The resort has padel courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: improve your game on our padel courts

verified_facts.text: The resort holds Green Key certification.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are proud to protect this natural environment, upholding sustainable values as recognized by our Green Key certification.

verified_facts.text: The resort does not offer on-site parking.
verified_facts.excerpt: JW Marriott Venice Resort & Spa does not offer on-site parking.

verified_facts.text: There is a family pool for splashing and another pool for adults seeking peace.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is a family pool dedicated to splashing and another for adults in search of peace.

verified_facts.text: The island is planted with palm trees, willow, lime, larch, magnolia, pines, horse chestnuts and Atlas cedars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wander beneath swaying palm trees, willow, lime, larch, and magnolia, alongside sky-reaching pines, shady horse chestnuts, and Atlas cedars
